description: Configuration the agent boots with for managing how readily it invents new phonological features (the invention_balance_threshold on its DevelopmentRoot). invention_balance_threshold is the starting bar (lower = invent more readily). invention_eps is the churn/settle cutoff on predicate movement. plateau_window is how many consecutive churn-with-impasses cycles count as the deadlock that forces easing. impasse_threshold is the recent-impasse level that counts as persistent disagreement. invention_floor/invention_ceiling bound the threshold. deadlock_ease_step/stable_ease_step are how much to lower it on a deadlock / clean coarse-feature signal; gentle_raise_step is how much to nudge it up while detectors are still settling. All dials live here, not in Python — the manage_feature_invention rule reads them off the root.
